title: Ephemeral ECDHE Handshakes
description: Negotiates ephemeral elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman keys per session so no long-term key can decrypt traffic. Each handshake generates fresh key pairs; after the session the keys are destroyed. It is the foundation of modern forward secrecy.

demo.title: Demo — Ephemeral ECDHE Handshakes

title: Double Ratchet Algorithm
description: Ratchets keys forward with every message using the Double Ratchet: a DH ratchet for new entropy and a symmetric ratchet per message. Compromise heals as soon as new DH shares arrive. Signal proved it at scale.

demo.title: Demo — Double Ratchet Algorithm

title: Session Ticket Rotation
description: Rotates TLS session-ticket encryption keys frequently to bound ticket compromise. Tickets enable resumption; rotating their keys limits what a stolen key decrypts. Rotation is automated on a schedule.
key_mechanisms: Keep old keys briefly for resumption

demo.title: Demo — Session Ticket Rotation

title: 0-RTT Tradeoff Analysis
description: Analyzes the 0-RTT tradeoff: faster resumption versus replay risk and weaker forward secrecy for early data. Applications must decide if their requests are replay-safe. The analysis, not the feature, is the technique.

demo.title: Demo — 0-RTT Tradeoff Analysis

title: HKDF Key Schedules
description: Derives session keys with HKDF extract-and-expand from the shared secret. Labels separate key purposes; each derivation is one-way. It is the standard key schedule construction.

demo.title: Demo — HKDF Key Schedules

title: Rotation Interval Policy
description: Sets key rotation intervals balancing exposure window against handshake cost. Shorter intervals mean less exposure per key; the policy encodes the organization's risk appetite. Intervals are enforced, not suggested.

demo.title: Demo — Rotation Interval Policy

title: Post-Compromise Security
description: Achieves post-compromise security: after a breach, new DH exchanges heal the session. The ratchet's DH steps inject fresh entropy the attacker lacks. Healing is automatic and fast.

demo.title: Demo — Post-Compromise Security

title: Hybrid PQ Key Exchange
description: Combines classical ECDHE with post-quantum KEMs so sessions survive either break. The hybrid secret mixes both; an attacker must break both to read traffic. It is the migration path to quantum safety.
key_mechanisms: Run ECDHE and KEM in parallel

demo.title: Demo — Hybrid PQ Key Exchange

title: Signal Protocol Sessions
description: Manages Signal protocol sessions with X3DH setup and Double Ratchet messaging. Prekeys enable asynchronous setup; the ratchet provides the secrecy properties. It is the reference secure-messaging design.

demo.title: Demo — Signal Protocol Sessions

title: TLS 1.3 Key Updates
description: Rotates traffic keys mid-connection with TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate messages. Long connections refresh keys without re-handshaking; both sides ratchet forward. It bounds the data encrypted under one key.

demo.title: Demo — TLS 1.3 Key Updates

title: Ratchet State Storage
description: Stores ratchet state securely with the same care as keys. State includes chain keys and DH pairs; leakage breaks future secrecy. Secure storage and memory hygiene apply.

demo.title: Demo — Ratchet State Storage

title: MLS Group Ratcheting
description: Ratchets keys for groups with Messaging Layer Security's tree-based design. TreeKEM scales group key agreement logarithmically; epochs advance on membership changes. It brings ratchets to group chat.

demo.title: Demo — MLS Group Ratcheting

title: Rotation Audit Trails
description: Audits key rotations with tamper-evident logs proving policy compliance. Every rotation is logged with timestamps; auditors verify intervals. It turns policy into evidence.

demo.title: Demo — Rotation Audit Trails

title: Downgrade Protection
description: Protects handshakes from downgrade to non-forward-secret ciphersuites. TLS 1.3 removed the weak options; version negotiation is authenticated. Attackers cannot force a weak deal.

demo.title: Demo — Downgrade Protection

title: Session Resumption Security
description: Secures session resumption so resumed sessions keep forward secrecy. PSK resumption in TLS 1.3 derives fresh keys; ticket keys rotate. Resumption is fast without being weak.

demo.title: Demo — Session Resumption Security
